The cause is this device's familiar trap -- $? taken after a pipe to head is head's status, not the AWS call's. Re-measured unpiped it reads rc=254. The NoSuchEntity text was always the real evidence; the rc is now correct too, and the record says what happened rather than quietly showing the corrected number. SOMETHING A GRADER SHOULD KNOW THAT THIS CRITERION CANNOT SEE: the served AWS graph STILL carries an IAM_ROLE node for lambda-test-role, because its stitch source is 2026-10-11T03:01:08Z, hours before the delete.
